title: Eight-sided polynomial tag decoding with 2 entries per list and prefix syndrome scoring with cumulative leader pair caps

claims.statement: The fixed product of five [400,200] components with length-eight polynomial tags and 2 relative-list entries per side has average block error at most 49724732691504417/50000000000000000 on the 2000-use BSC(1/10) for uniform 1000-bit data, when decoded by the counted program in proof.md.
The same bsc-ops-v1 program executes exactly W=143252 primitives for every received word and W<=2^(85641/5000).

experiments.purpose: Check local tag and quotient rank spectra, then one exact or Hölder support profile. Last sector combines profiles and checks exact error and instruction bounds.
